text:
Noah (Design): dropping a compact checklist prototype -> https://www.figma.com/file/compact/onboard-checklist
Noah (Design): idea: first-run shows a 3-step inline checklist (Connect repo, Pick starter, Configure secrets) with minimal copy and keyboard-first flow.
Priya (PM): I like the momentum. main question: should 'Skip' be primary for quick users or secondary to encourage completion?
Noah (Design): propose primary = 'Continue' and a subtle 'Skip for now' link. but add a second path: if user clicks 'Skip', offer an inline quick action to init a default sample.
Alex (Frontend): implementation note: keep everything in a single banner region to avoid jumping to separate pages. we'll progressively reveal step content in-place.
Hana (DevEx): perf note: avoid heavy API calls early. repo connection should be an OAuth popup or token paste; detect repo metadata client-side where possible.
Riley (A11y): keyboard-first requirements: 1) focus trap within checklist while open, 2) clear skip link keyboard order, 3) aria-current on active step, 4) announcements when step completes.
Noah (Design): visual: compact progress (3 dots + labels), each step has a short 1-line helper. CTAs: primary (Continue/Finish), secondary (Back), tertiary link (Skip).
Priya (PM): copy candidates for the finishing CTA: 'Finish setup', 'Complete onboarding', 'Get me a project'. prefer 'Finish setup' — clearer.
Alex (Frontend): we'll animate height changes with CSS to avoid layout shift. when a step reveals new fields, do not steal focus unless user submits.
Hana (DevEx): secret handling: show placeholders for env vars, include a 'Use demo secrets' option that populates safe defaults client-side. must warn about real secrets.
Riley (A11y): ensure the 'Use demo secrets' is announced: role=button + accessible name and a confirmation dialog accessible by keyboard.
Noah (Design): microcopy for repo connect step: 'Connect your repo to let us suggest suitable starters.' privacy CTA: 'We only read filenames in your browser.' links to docs.
Priya (PM): metrics: fire onboarding_step_shown/completed, skip_clicked, demo_secrets_used. keep events minimal and opt-out friendly.
Alex (Frontend): keyboard flow: Tab order should go: step content -> primary CTA -> skip link -> next step. if user uses arrow keys, they can move steps too.
Hana (DevEx): session persistence: store progress in sessionStorage so accidental refresh doesn't lose state; persist to profile only after explicit completion.
Riley (A11y): accessible progress: use `aria-valuemin/max/now` pattern and also text like 'Step 2 of 3' visible to screen readers.
Noah (Design): small UX edge: if repo connect fails, show inline help and a retry button; avoid modal error pages.
Priya (PM): decision: primary CTA = Continue/Finish, Skip visible but low-contrast, demo secrets opt-in explicit. Legal to sign off on privacy text.
onboard-bot: Preview for feature/compact-checklist -> https://preview.redwood.ai/compact-checklist (staging)
Noah (Design): next steps: I'll post updated frames with exact copy and aria attributes. can someone pair on SR walkthrough?
Riley (A11y): I can run a screen reader pass tomorrow AM. will check focus, announcements, and the demo secrets dialog.
Alex (Frontend): will prototype the inline flow this week and wire a11y hooks. thanks!
